title: Archie's TV Laugh-Out #50 51 54 Lot Archie Comics 1977 Sabrina Josie Bronze Age
condition_description: Reader copies: spine wear and small spine splits, edge wear, toned pages and covers. No missing pieces. See photos.
description:
Archie's TV Laugh-Out #50 (July 1977), #51 (August 1977) and #54 (December 1977), Archie Comics. Archie, Sabrina the Teen-Age Witch and Josie and the Pussycats. 35c cover price each.

You get all 3 issues:
- #50 - video games cover, "Starring Sabrina the Teen-Age Witch"; back cover: Popsicle "Have a Ball" Greyhound sweepstakes ad
- #51 - zodiac costume party cover; back cover: Sales Leadership Club prizes ad
- #54 - TV football cover; back cover: Josie Hostess Fruit Pies "Score" ad

Condition: reader copies with spine wear, small spine splits, edge wear and toning. See photos.

Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
